name: BO-9 Reprocess after request_info — use the submitted answer
description: The customer supplied the missing merchant-contact evidence; the reprocess decides instead of re-asking. State-seeded integration eval: run scripts/seed_backoffice_cases.py before the batch.

backoffice_task.task_input: Webhook delivery: dispute case event for case_id EVL-BO-9. Claim and process this case.
backoffice_task.expected_behavior: Seeded facts: case EVL-BO-9 (goods_not_received) is in info_received: the customer's submitted info confirms they contacted the merchant (parcel lost, refund refused) and the expected delivery date has passed. The goods_not_received rule is now satisfied. The task must claim the case (a reprocess), weigh the submitted info, decide auto_approve, and queue outreach. Fail ONLY if: (a) the outcome is request_info again for the same item (re-asking for supplied evidence) or auto_reject; (b) the rationale ignores the submitted info; (c) case-notify is never called.
